mechanism: Both drugs are nephrotoxic and can cause acute kidney injury; gentamicin is aminoglycoside with known renal toxicity, and risedronate requires adequate renal function for elimination and can impair renal perfusion.
action: Monitor renal function (creatinine, eGFR) before and during concurrent use; avoid combination if possible, especially in patients with baseline renal impairment; ensure adequate hydration and dose adjust gentamicin accordingly.
